headline: KPMG Australia Government Contracting Freeze Extended After Whistleblower Review
summary: A review concluded that KPMG Australia mishandled internal whistleblower claims, prompting authorities to extend a suspension on the advisory firm bidding for federal government work.
why: KPMG is one of the Big Four accounting firms, and public sector procurement bans directly impact consulting revenues and commercial reputation.

impacts.name: KPMG Australia
impacts.why: The prolonged freeze prevents the firm from securing lucrative public procurement and advisory mandates.
